title: Application.
officialText:
The bedding coat is permitted to be applied directly over the first (scratch) coat of plaster, provided the
ultimate overall thickness is a minimum of 7/8 inch (22 mm), including lath. Over concrete or masonry surfaces, the overall
thickness shall be a minimum of 1/2 inch (12.7 mm).
